title: Heavenly Light Turkish Chocolate Mousse
description: A light and romantic Turkish dessert featuring brandy and tempered chocolate, perfect for special occasions
instructions: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler over low heat, stirring occasionally
Remove the chocolate from the heat and let it cool slightly
Whip the heavy cream until it forms stiff peaks and set it aside
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg whites and granulated sugar until stiff peaks form
Fold the egg mixture into the cooled chocolate until well combined
Add the brandy, kosher salt, and vanilla extract to the chocolate mixture and fold until smooth
Fold the whipped cream into the chocolate mixture until no white streaks remain
Divide the mousse into individual mini cocottes and chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours
